notes: Used to express that you need sleep or rest. Do not confuse this with 'moeizaam' (laborious/difficult).
In Dutch, you can say 'ik ben moe' (I am tired). To express 'tired of' something, use 'moe van': 'Ik ben moe van het wachten' (I am tired of waiting).

senses.definition: Feeling that you need sleep or rest.

examples.text: Ik ben erg moe na een lange werkdag.

examples.emotion: drained and ready to head home for the night

senses.definition: Having had enough of something or someone.
